_comment: Per-prop calibration applied in finalizePrediction. anchor_weight: share of the model's deviation from the line that survives (0 = always the line). prob_shrink: multiplier on the distance of the over probability from 50. Regenerate with: node backend/scripts/calibrateProps.mjs --write

_edge_prob_shrink.note: 1 = no shrink. The live probability map (models/edge_probability_map.json, fitted 2026-10-31 on this season) carries its own calibration, so the pooled 0.2 shrink that covered the old map is retired. Restore ~0.2 only if the live map is removed.
